entries.name: Gregory Distribution, 280 Ernesettle Lane, Plymouth, Devon, PL5 2SA, United Kingdom
entries.notes: Loading/logistics only. Rare alternate I.13 depot (roughly every 6 months) for Saputo Davidstow (GB CQ 501) cheese exports, alongside North Tawton and Cullompton. I.11 Place of dispatch remains Davidstow (GB CQ 501) regardless of loading depot. Added v4.6.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, Saunders Way, Cullompton, EX15 1BS
entries.notes: Loading/logistics only. Confirmed occasional alternate I.13 depot for the Saputo Davidstow (GB CQ 501) cheese lane specifically (Ingredient Solutions Ltd / Rosslare route). Not used on the SWP/whey powder (Novades) lane, which continues via Purfleet, Felixstowe and Heathfield. Added v4.6.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, North Tawton (Cat 3 transport approval)
entries.notes: Transport/logistics approval — Cat 3 only. Applies to Saputo/Davidstow Cat 3 loads on 8322 certificates only. Not the I.11 entry for AFI powder loads — see the N/A entry below. Scope clarified v4.7.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, North Tawton, Devon, EX20 2EB (AFI Taw Valley powder loads)
entries.notes: Standard I.11 for AFI Taw Valley powder loads — bagged/palletised, identified by I.27 Type of packaging ≠ BULK TANKER. Loading/logistics only. Distinct from AFI bulk tanker loads, where I.11 = Taw Valley Creamery, GB DE 030 (see E73), and from the Cat 3 transport approval U1183488/TRANS above. Key this entry on I.27 packaging type, never on trailer type. Added v4.7.
